log_file.description: Path to the log file; leave empty to log to stderr only.

web_addr.description: IP address to bind the web server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '::').

web_port.description: Port number for the Chef API server.

use_ssl.description: Enable TLS/SSL for secure Chef API communication.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the server TLS certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the server TLS private key file (PEM format).

client_cert_verify.description: Enforce mutual TLS (mTLS) by verifying client certificates.

client_ca_cert_file.description: Path to the CA certificate for validating client certs (required if mTLS is enabled).

data_dir.description: Directory for persistent data storage (nodes, cookbooks, etc.).

db_backend.description: Database backend to use for storing Chef data.

sqlite_file.description: Path to the SQLite database file (only used if db_backend=sqlite).

mysql_host.description: MySQL server hostname or IP address.

mysql_password.description: MySQL password (leave empty to use socket auth or keyring).

mysql_max_open_conns.description: Maximum number of open MySQL connections.

postgresql_host.description: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP address.

postgresql_max_open_conns.description: Maximum number of open PostgreSQL connections.

chef_zero_compat.description: Enable compatibility mode for Chef Zero clients (e.g., older knife-zero).

enable_search.description: Enable built-in full-text search for nodes, roles, etc.

worker_count.description: Number of goroutines handling concurrent I/O-bound operations (e.g., uploads, DB queries).

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of simultaneous cookbook or file uploads.

webhooks.description: List of webhook configurations to emit events (e.g., node change notifications).

method.description: HTTP method for the webhook request

headers.description: List of HTTP headers as key-value pairs (e.g., [{'Content-Type': 'application/json'}])

default_node_attributes.description: Default attributes to apply to all new nodes (nested keys allowed).

enable_cors.description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) for browser clients.

cors_origins.description: List of allowed CORS origins (supports wildcards like '*.example.com').

cors_credentials.description: Allow credentials (cookies, auth headers) in CORS requests.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds before idle HTTP connections are closed.

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum allowed request body size (in bytes).

metrics_token.description: Authentication token required to access /metrics (optional but recommended).

server_version_string.description: Version string returned in the 'Server' HTTP header (useful for hiding internal details).

node_attribute_whitelist_enabled.description: Enable whitelist mode to restrict which node attributes clients may set.

node_attribute_whitelist.description: List of allowed node attribute namespaces (e.g., 'automatic', 'automatic/kernel').

enable_chef_vault.description: Enable Chef Vault support for encrypted data bags.

enable_audit_logging.description: Enable request auditing (all Chef API calls logged to audit_log_file).

audit_log_file.description: Path to the audit log file (used only if audit logging is enabled).

enable_run_list_expansion.description: Enable recursive run-list expansion for roles and environments.

knife_zero_compat.description: Enable legacy compatibility with knife-zero (e.g., bootstrap command behavior).

enable_key_rotation.description: Enable support for client key rotation via the chef-client run.
